background: ING Groep is the holding company of the Netherlands' largest bank, a digital-first retail and wholesale bank funded by deposits across the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany and other European markets, lending on mortgages and to corporates worldwide.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, A on average with the weakest at A-, both on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 14 Apr 2016. Capital is on the weak side of EU and Nordic banks, with CET1 of 13.1% and leverage of 4.2% both in the bottom quarter, and LCR of 137% is in the bottom quarter too. NSFR of 128% is above the median, though it has fallen 5 points since 30 Jun 2025; the other ratios have held steady (figures to 30 Jun 2026).
